_comment: Encounter tuning. Suspicion is hidden (never shown). Each encounter keeps its own count: 'start' is where it begins, 'flaggedStart' replaces it while the border crossing card is flagged (flag card_flagged). Booth: 'heldAt' and up the officer holds the passport a moment; 'secondaryAt' and up sends Mateo to secondary inspection. Secondary: 'refuseAt' and up is refused entry. Dialogue data reads these as "@encounters.booth.secondaryAt" etc. keyQuestionMs: time to answer a key (timed) question.
